summary:
BioVanguard-X is an interactive 3D International Space Station (ISS) Medical Bay diagnostic and telemetry platform built to empower astronauts on long-duration space missions to autonomously monitor, interpret, and manage their physiological health.

Instead of relying on static mockups, BioVanguard-X drives real-time telemetry across 11 specialized medical stations using biological thresholds derived directly from 10 peer-reviewed NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) studies (including OSD-575, OSD-816, OSD-530, and OSD-984). The platform features three core mechanics:

1.Interconnected Risk Cascades: Simulates how primary spaceflight stressors—such as Galactic Cosmic Ray radiation or microgravity cephalad fluid shifts—trigger secondary biological risks across ocular, cardiovascular, immune, and neurological systems.

2.Transparent Diagnostics: Whenever vitals cross Yellow or Red thresholds, the system cites the exact NASA OSDR study ID and explains the underlying biological mechanism, alongside an automated Situation Report (SitRep) generator.

3.Actionable Countermeasures: Astronauts can activate Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP), exercise rehab, or neural sleep modulation to stabilize simulated vitals in real time.
details:
1. What does it do and how does it work?

BioVanguard-X models real-time telemetry across 11 specialized medical stations. Rather than tracking isolated vitals, the platform simulates interconnected causal cascades—illustrating how primary spaceflight stressors (such as Galactic Cosmic Ray [GCR] radiation doses or microgravity-induced cephalad fluid shifts) propagate secondary systemic risks across ocular, cardiovascular, immune, and musculoskeletal systems. When parameters cross study-calibrated Yellow or Red thresholds, crew members can engage interactive countermeasures (such as ARED axial skeletal loading or Lower Body Negative Pressure [LBNP]) to stabilize physiological drift in real time.

2. Tools, Coding Languages, & Software Used

  • Frontend & Architecture: Built using Vite, React, and TypeScript for high-performance, modular telemetry rendering.
  • Development Environment: Generated and structured via Gemini Hydrogen / Google AI Studio.
  • Scientific & Data Integration: Grounded empirically using parameters extracted from 10 peer-reviewed NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) studies, including OSD-530, OSD-569, OSD-575, OSD-656, OSD-816, OSD-897, OSD-941, OSD-984, and OSD-1018.

3. Impact & Innovation

BioVanguard-X removes reliance on delayed Earth-based ground control by providing astronauts with autonomous, transparent diagnostics that explicitly cite underlying NASA OSDR biological mechanisms, complete with an automated Situation Report (SitRep) generator.
